messages:
emma_support: FYI — Acct 3345 (ACME Logistics) submitted a VAT-exemption / reverse-charge request. VIES returned a name mismatch vs invoice. I've put invoice INV-2026-3345 on hold because PO + tax evidence required. Can billing advise next steps?

billing-bot: VIES lookup result for DE VAT `DE123456789`: status=active; registry_name=\"ACME LOGISTICS LTD\"; invoice_name=\"Acme Logistics GmbH\"; score=low_name_match. (vies.api v1.3)

sanjay_billing: thanks. name mismatch is common. we need either: 1) official Handelsregister extract showing legal names + VAT ID OR 2) resale/certificate showing they can be reverse-charged. if customer provides docs we can do a manual override but need an audit trail and legal sign-off for DE.

lisa_account: customer replied in Zendesk with two attachments and a link. uploading to thread: https://zendesk.redwood/agent/tickets/8812 and gdrive: https://drive.redwood/acme/regs. they say the English name is used on invoices but legal name is \"ACME Logistics Ltd\" per register.

ops-escalations: Do NOT release payment yet. If we do a manual tax-exempt override we must: attach docs (HRB or company extract), note who approved, and set a reversible flag so we can revert if tax authorities query. Also log in audit.

legal-eu: Quick check: for DE we require Handelsregister (HRB) extract OR an official VAT confirmation PDF matching the VAT ID. If attachments match and the VAT ID is active, legal will sign off. Send docs to me in the ZD ticket and I’ll review.

sanjay_billing: Uploaded doc snapshots to the invoice and ZD ticket. Applying manual override now for bookkeeping so accounting can accept the PO flow. Command run: 
```
invoice_tool --apply-override --invoice INV-2026-3345 --tax_exempt true --reason "manual: HRB + VIES screenshot attached" --approver sanjay_billing
```
Override status: PENDING_LEGAL_REVIEW. ledger note added: `manual override requested 1876543278 by sanjay_billing`.

billing-bot: System update: invoice INV-2026-3345 set to HOLD -> PENDING_PAYMENT. tax_flag=reverse_charge (temp). audit_ref=ZD-8812.

legal-eu: I reviewed the HRB PDF and VAT confirmation. Names and VAT ID line up when taking alt trading name into account. OK to clear the manual override. I'll add approval note to ZD-8812.

sanjay_billing: cleared override and moved invoice to READY_FOR_PAYMENT. note: keep docs attached for 10y per audit. tagging finance to pick up payment once PO arrives.

emma_support: thanks team :thumbsup: I told the customer the invoice is ready and we just need their PO number to release payment. closing loop in ticket ZD-8812.
